text:
Alice: Heads-up: entering a soft-freeze for the v2.3 launch window at 2026-03-22 01:00 UTC. Post any exemption requests here. @deploy-bot will hold pins. :lock:
Ben: got it. who needs to approve hotfix exemptions?
Alice: PM signoff + release lead (@Alice) required. no schema migrations during this window.
Deploy-bot: [automated] pinned release v2.3-20260322 to prod, owner=@Alice, expires=2026-03-22T03:00Z :white_check_mark:
Carla: infra — can I run a full smoke in staging at 00:50? I'll trigger checks and post summary.
Dave: I'll be on rollback watch. Rollback plan: pin back to v2.2, shift traffic to north cluster, and freeze new traffic until manual OK.
Emma: added ops note: telemetry retention toggled to 7d for the launch window to avoid storage SLO blips.
Ben: are heavy batch jobs (embeddings/retrain) suppressed during the window?
Alice: confirmed — all non-critical batch jobs suppressed 01:00-04:00 UTC.
Carla: staging smoke results: 95p latency <220ms, error-rate 0.2% (non-user-facing). no blocking issues. pushing canary at 01:05 unless objections.
Ben: +1. also turned off nightly cleanup to avoid transient lat spikes.
Dave: launch ramp plan: canary -> 10% at 01:15 -> 50% at 01:30 -> 100% at 01:45. Manual halt if relative error spike >20% for 5m.
Emma: adding golden prompt regression test "launch-2026-03": must be <0.03 delta before 50% ramp.
Carla: deploying canary 01:05 now. logs:
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/realtime-v2 --namespace=prod-canary
# watch pods, check readiness and prometheus alerts
```
Deploy-bot: canary pinned to v2.3-20260322-canary by @Carla :rocket:
Carla: canary smoke looks clean. perf delta +3% on cost metrics; within threshold.
Alice: proceeding per Dave's ramp. @ops-oncall standing by to cut traffic if needed.
Ops-oncall: standing by. will cut traffic if error-rate breach persists for >5m.
Ben: release-notes updated: https://redwood.docs/releases/v2.3 — includes migration steps and fast rollback commands.
Alice: reminder: after 01:30 UTC no more code changes unless PM-approved hotfix. tag @Alice for signoff. :lock:
Emma: emergency unpin procedure: `deploy-bot unpin v2.3-20260322 --force` then follow rollback-runbook. note: unpin alerts #release-war-room and requires 2 approvals.
Dave: request to lock embeddings cron now prior to full ramp.
Carla: suppressed cron: `kubectl scale cronjob/embeddings-retrain --replicas=0` — done.
Ben: can we confirm canary metrics dashboard link? https://grafana.redwood/prod/canary/realtime-v2 — looks green.
Alice: thumbs up. final operational checklist:
- pin verified
- batch jobs suppressed
- telemetry retention set
- golden prompt check configured
- release-notes published
- ops oncall assigned
If any check fails during ramp, trigger rollback.
Carla: 50% ramp at 01:30 starting now. monitoring closely.
Dave: 50% looks stable, errors baseline within 0.6%. proceed to 100% at 01:45.
Ben: noting a small spike in db connections during 50% — watching.
Emma: golden prompt regression returned 0.018 — OK.
Alice: if no regressions, we'll call this green. Postmortem only if >1% regression or customer impact. great job all. :tada:
